paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between vocab size and two types of complexity, input complexity and embedding complexity. The x-axis represents vocab size, with a linear scale ranging from 8,000 to 42,000. The y-axis, labeled "Scaled Ratio", has a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot features two lines: a blue line representing input complexity, which starts at approximately (8,000, 1.0) and decreases steadily to near (42,000, 0.0), with a circular marker and a solid line style; and a teal line representing embedding complexity, which starts at approximately (8,000, 0.0) and increases steadily to near (42,000, 1.0), also with a circular marker and a solid line style.
